name: What are the benefits of converting a garage into an ADU?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of converting a garage into an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting an existing garage into an ADU can be a cost-effective and time-efficient option compared to new construction, as it often utilizes existing foundations and walls. This approach minimizes disruption to your main property and can be a good way to add living space without sacrificing yard area. However, it requires careful planning to ensure proper insulation, utilities, and compliance with residential living standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage conversions are cost-effective and quicker than new ADU construction, using existing structures and minimizing yard disruption, but need careful planning for compliance.
